reclaim.description: Maximize safe RAM reclaim — compress in place, never auto-quit

footprint.description: Keep ram-park and Gauge server cold import under 28 MB

safety.description: BLOCK or PASS — consent, Cursor, browsers/media guards

verify.description: Run tests, footprint, ram once, self-check

launch.description: Pro + distribution phases 0–6 — customer as god; no paid blasts before Setapp

gauge_lazy.prompt: Gauge: snapshot-only reads via ram_snapshot; load ram-park.py only for _PARK_ACTIONS (watcher, picker, cleanup, once, quit, pagesweep_apply). compress_apply and jetsam_thaw stay lightweight.

gauge_ia.prompt: Gauge IA per notes/GAUGE_UI.md + notes/GAUGE_TASKS.md: sidebar nav, Smart Reclaim home, hide engine module grid on Home. One primary CTA. Read CONFIG.md — ship UI only; Advanced behind Settings.

gauge_smart_reclaim.prompt: Smart Reclaim per GAUGE_UI.md: one bundled action — attention gate, compress idle apps, freeze clean tabs. Never quit in this action. POST endpoint + summary payload (apps compressed, tabs frozen, MB). dry_run banner when preview.

gauge_motion.prompt: Gauge motion per GAUGE_UI.md: ring stroke ease ~600ms, reclaim progress arc, post-run summary card animate-in. Avoid motion on Advanced panel.

gauge_menubar.prompt: Menu bar popover per GAUGE_UI.md: free GB, pressure word + tint, compressed MB, last reclaim age, Smart Reclaim button, Open Gauge. Native host wraps same web IA/API.

gauge_settings.prompt: Gauge Settings: Work/Gaming/Battery presets map to attention+battery keys in ship defaults only. Optional sound toggle (off in browser dev dashboard, on default for menu bar app). No personal app lists in defaults.

config_ship.prompt: Verify CONFIG.md ship split: config.defaults.json universal (dry_run false, minimal never_quit); new installs seed {}; config.local.json gitignored maintainer-only; config-apply-local applies local overrides. tests/test_ram_config.py passes.

launchd_rss.prompt: launchd `ram once`: bind attention early; skip arc/mmap when disabled; battery+normal skips run_compression_reclaim entirely. Measure RSS before/after.

reclaim_crash.prompt: Ensure pass_runner and experience imports present; ram once must not self-destruct.

idle_attention.prompt: idle_minutes_for_app must delegate to attention.idle_minutes_for (unknown app = 999m idle, compress-eligible).

gauge_cleanup.prompt: Gauge cleanup calls run_compression_reclaim (full compress stack, no quits) with attention bound.

battery_defer.prompt: Gate tlb/mmap/cpucache/mach_ipc with battery_policy; skip heavy reclaim on battery normal ticks.

compress_path.prompt: Tier-1 reclaim per RAM_VALUE_STACK; game defer + only_background.

creative_presence.prompt: Presence-weighted discard/freeze — idle past learned return time only. Never unsaved work.

creative_coalition.prompt: Safe subset of duplicate mmap invalidate — read-only scan first, sudo gated.

creative_gpu.prompt: Idle GPU texture / IOSurface flush for background apps — defer on battery; never kill host.

creative_xpc.prompt: Trim idle XPC proxy services attached to heavy apps — no host quit.

creative_launchd.prompt: launchd tick budget — normal+battery skip contrib import; warn/critical only load full reclaim stack.

creative_loop.prompt: Improve peer loop UX — auto-build next prompt from CREATIVE_RECLAIM; --clipboard-only fresh chat hint.

creative_compressor.prompt: Compressor-aware compress targeting — anonymous vs file-backed pressure.

creative_mine.prompt: Mine non-obvious compress-in-place wins: audit tiers 1–2 + anti-patterns; add ≥3 experiments to CREATIVE_RECLAIM; implement highest ROI; set ## Loop: exhausted only if truly nothing clever remains.

creative_jetsam.prompt: Jetsam soft-hint / compress-first — picker candidates only, never auto-quit; Cursor excluded; AFK+critical gated.

creative_wire.prompt: Idle wire-budget throttle / hysteresis — browsers only after leaving frontmost; never Cursor; restore on focus.

creative_filecache.prompt: Presence-weighted purgeable file cache — learned return + AFK; skip recent touch.

creative_shared_cache.prompt: Idle shared-cache advise for non-browser/media; never demote browsers/media/Cursor.

creative_attention.prompt: Presence aggressiveness ramp — scale reclaim intensity by learned absence; keep defer-while-in-use.

creative_chrome_media.prompt: Paused-tab media buffer flush — clean idle tabs only; no unsaved work; never auto-close.

generic_reclaim.prompt: Implement queue item; apps stay open; read SAFETY_GATES + CREATIVE_RECLAIM. Prefer backtick module scopes in the item over guessing electron/chrome.

git_hygiene.prompt: git add (no .config/ secrets), commit with clear message, confirm clean tree.

automation_audit.prompt: Run peer_orchestrate --self-check and tests.test_automation; fix ISSUES; sync WORK_QUEUE with self_improve_context.

launch_newdrop.prompt: LAUNCH Phase 0.1: Newdrop at getnewdrop.com — git-sync CHANGELOG.md, public /c/ram-park, Gauge What's New embed stub. Update CHANGELOG.md; do not publish secrets.

launch_pro_gauge.prompt: LAUNCH Phase 0.2 umbrella: follow notes/GAUGE_TASKS.md order (IA → Smart Reclaim → motion → menu bar → Settings). Read notes/GAUGE_UI.md + CONFIG.md. Free CLI + safety gates unchanged.

launch_billing.prompt: LAUNCH Phase 0.3: Pro billing Stripe/Paddle $10/mo + $79/yr, cancel anytime. Never paywall safety/consent reclaim. See MONETIZATION.md.

launch_landing.prompt: LAUNCH Phase 0.4–0.5: landing page + demo assets checklist; free vs Pro matrix; link Newdrop changelog.

launch_github.prompt: LAUNCH Phase 1: GitHub public + v0.1.0 release + topics. Repo private until Phase 0 exit criteria met (LAUNCH.md).

launch_setapp.prompt: LAUNCH Phase 3: Setapp application + onboard if accepted. Primary curated Mac blast. Human submits developer.setapp.com — prepare pitch + notarized Pro assets.

launch_spike.prompt: LAUNCH Phase 4: free spike (Product Hunt / Show HN / Crowdstax / MacStories tip). Only after Phase 2 soft launch stable. Human posts — agent prepares copy/assets from LAUNCH.md.

launch_paid_gate.prompt: LAUNCH Phase 6: paid newsletter sponsorship — BLOCK automation. Gate: Setapp live ≥30d OR $1k/mo organic. Human decision only; do not purchase ads.

launch_ops.prompt: LAUNCH Phase 0.7: customer-first ops — refund path, support email, Newdrop Publish checklist on each user-facing release.

product_constraints: Consent: compress aggressively, never auto-quit apps/tabs
Cursor never closed; browsers/media never E-core demoted
Smart tab freeze: clean tabs only, learned return times, AFK >= 90s
Closing apps = cheating (no efficiency gain) — compress in place
Launch: follow LAUNCH.md phases 0→6 in order; Phase 0 ship before Phase 4 spikes
No paid newsletter sponsorship before Setapp live (Phase 6 gate — human only)
Pro: customer as god — never paywall safety or consent
User-facing release: update CHANGELOG.md then Newdrop Publish
Ship config: config.defaults.json universal; maintainer overrides in config.local.json only (CONFIG.md)
Gauge UI: Smart Reclaim bundles compress + tab freeze; no quit in primary CTA (notes/GAUGE_UI.md)
